manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0126; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target-bearing learner lines “It was two days ago.” and “It was three days ago.” are grammatical and natural for the bounded ago sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps ago to «پیش» and preserves the intended meaning across dialogue and activities.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors are short A1 alternatives with plausible surface form but clearly different meaning; none is a duplicate of the keyed answer.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner production stays short and controlled; no new grammar claim is added and only one lexical target is scored.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the immediate context while preserving the same bounded sense of ago.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, construction, scenario, learner turns, choices, and final retrieval all align to the same lexical objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
